claims: John Calipari is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Arkansas.
John Calipari was hired on April 10, 2024.
John Calipari was head coach at Kentucky from 2009 to 2024.
John Calipari is a Naismith Hall of Fame coach.
John Calipari has multiple Final Four appearances.
John Calipari is a National Championship winner.
Kelsi Musick was named the head coach of Arkansas women's basketball on March 21, 2025.
Travis Ford was named the men's head coach at UALR (Little Rock) in March 2026
